description: This file defines the InMemoryReminderTable class which implements reminder table functionality using in-memory storage within the Orleans runtime framework. It manages reminder entries, interacts with a grain interface, and handles lifecycle events such as start and stop, making the reminder service available or unavailable accordingly.

classes.name: InMemoryReminderTable
classes.description: Implements an in-memory reminder table for Orleans, providing methods for reading, updating, and removing reminder entries, and managing its lifecycle states.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the reminder table, currently a no-op.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry based on grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: ReadRows (GrainId)
methods.description: Reads all reminder entries for a specific grain.

methods.name: ReadRows (uint, uint)
methods.description: Reads reminder entries within a range, if available.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a reminder row based on grain ID, name, and eTag.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears all reminder entries, intended for testing.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Updates or inserts a reminder entry.

methods.name: ThrowIfNotAvailable
methods.description: Throws an exception if the reminder service is not available.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Handles lifecycle events to set the availability of the reminder table on application start and stop.
